# inscription carrier

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:inscriptionCarrier`](gmeow-inscriptionCarrier.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/inscriptionCarrier>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)

The physical object that bears an inscription. Functional: an inscription is borne by exactly one carrier (if a copy exists on another carrier, it is a distinct [`Inscription`](../classes/gmeow-Inscription.md) instance).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Inscription`](../classes/gmeow-Inscription.md) -> [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md); functional

Use [`gmeow:inscriptionCarrier`](gmeow-inscriptionCarrier.md) from [`gmeow:Inscription`](../classes/gmeow-Inscription.md) to [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
